project_context.design_goal: Warm, family-friendly, organized, trustworthy, highly accessible.

theme_archetype.e1_twist: Neo-Brutalist Softness. Pair warm pastels with structural elements like 1px warm-grey borders to prevent the UI from looking purely childish. Maintain high visual structure for organization.

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Bento style for Today's view. Large asymmetrical cards rather than repetitive equal lists.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped, chunky, solid colors. No drop shadows to maintain flat/soft UI look. Use subtle opacity feedback on press.
components.bottom_sheets: Use for Event Creation, Member Management, and Schedule Type assignment. Dimmed background (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)), rounded top corners (24px).
components.calendar_month_view: Flat grid layout. Avoid generic square cell borders. Use soft rounded indicator dots under dates for each scheduled member. Selected day expands into an elevated floating card.
components.calendar_day_view: Vertical timeline. Schedule blocks take the background color of the Member. The Schedule Type (e.g., Infantário, Office) is displayed as bold text with a matching icon.
components.member_management: List of members with swipe-to-delete/edit actions. Distinct 'Invite Family Member' prominent button.
components.schedule_types_config: CRUD list to manage codes (INF, OFC, etc). Show chips to associate schedule types strictly to permitted members.

testing_requirements.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. In React Native, map this logically to the testID prop.

assets.icons: Phosphor Icons (React Native SVG compatible). Clean, duotone preferred.

images.description: 3D soft clay illustration of a happy family managing a giant colorful calendar, warm pastel colors.
3D soft clay illustration of a relaxing cozy living room, empty schedule.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Expo React Native project. Use standard JavaScript (.js).
Integrate Supabase for backend synchronization. Tables: Family, Users, ScheduleTypes, UserScheduleAssignments, DailySchedules.
Implement Authentication (Email/Password) linking users to a Family ID.
Pre-seed or allow easy addition of User1, User2, User3 upon Family creation.
Implement distinct schedule types management (ID, Code, Name, Description). Assign these types specifically to members (e.g., User1: INF, Casa).
Add 'Export to PDF' for Month View (using expo-print or related library).
Add logic for sending invites to new members via email.
Prepare Android Home Screen Widget (requires native modules/Expo config plugins for Android AppWidgetProvider) showing today's schedules.
Apply styling rules exactly as described. Use Nunito and Quicksand via expo-font.
Ensure all interactive components have the data-testid prop defined for automated testing.
